title: Measure farther than you step
literal_meaning: Measure a cubit, then move a span.
explanation: Examine more of the situation than the immediate step requires. The proverb recommends deliberation before acting; careful preparation can reduce risk without guaranteeing safety.
meaning_odia: ଆଗକୁ ଭଲଭାବେ ବୁଝି ବିଚାରି ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ନେବା। ଯେତିକି କାମ କରିବା, ତାଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଦୂରର ଫଳ ଭାବିବା।
usage_example: Before moving a workshop, its owners check access, costs and likely demand, then try a small temporary space. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary itself explains the longer measure and shorter step. These are traditional body-based measures; no fixed modern conversion is needed here.
